description: Flood — Awareness — Storm Tide is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset, created in June 2013, provides an indication of the likelihood of a flood occurring from storm tide inside the Brisbane City Council local government area. This layer contributes to the storm tide Flood Awareness Map. Storm tide flooding happens when a storm surge creates higher than normal sea levels. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are arcgis, environment, fam, fio, flood. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2025-06-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
